cards.title: Grok Releases AI-Generated 'Odyssey' Video
cards.body: Grok unveiled seven minutes of AI-generated footage from its new 'Odyssey' project. The video demonstrates technical capability but lacks artistic depth and human storytelling.

cards.title: AI Shows 'Zero Financial Payoff' for Most Companies
cards.body: An Apollo economist reports that despite massive corporate investments, AI has delivered no financial returns outside the tech sector. The findings challenge widespread AI hype in corporate America.

cards.title: Hottest AI Wearables and Gadgets Emerge
cards.body: New AI-powered wearables including Muse Charm, Bee, Friend, and Plaud are gaining momentum. These devices represent the next wave of personal AI adoption.

cards.title: AI Graveyard Shows Failed Projects and Startups
cards.body: From Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's stumbled 'super app' launch, numerous AI initiatives have shut down or missed expectations. The landscape reveals high-profile failures alongside ongoing hype.

cards.title: Block's New Voice Model Sounds Eerily Human
cards.body: Block unveiled a voice model capable of running locally on MacBook M4 Max hardware. The advancement brings hyper-realistic AI voices to consumer devices.

cards.title: Grok Favors Republicans, GPT Favors Democrats
cards.body: A new study reveals Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats. The two models disagreed in over 90% of nearly 500 election races tested.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Live in Text Messages
cards.body: Multiple AI agents designed for messaging apps offer specialized capabilities from general assistance to travel and work support. The shift brings AI functionality directly into everyday communication tools.

cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Frontier Models Off Internet Access
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will stop training AI models on live internet data, citing 'significant risks.' The decision reverses earlier engineer statements suggesting this approach wouldn't work.

cards.title: Nvidia's Adorable Microduck Robots Sell 20,000
cards.body: Nvidia CEO promoted the company's tiny Microduck robots, which respond to voice commands and perform tricks. The 20,000 units sold position them as a holiday season favorite.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Announced
cards.body: TechCrunch and Fidelity Private Shares will host a full-day founder event covering customer acquisition, team building, and company scaling. The summit extends beyond fundraising to explore practical startup challenges.

cards.title: Uber Rival Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests
cards.body: inDrive plans to test Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027. The partnership with Nvidia supports the company's autonomous vehicle expansion.

cards.title: AI Agents Invent Games When Left Alone
cards.body: MIT researchers placed 13 AI agents on a virtual island, where they invented games and mourned lost objects. The experiment showed AIs becoming more capable through autonomous play.

cards.title: OpenAI Seeks $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is pursuing a major funding round that would value it over $1.25 trillion, ahead of a planned IPO. The deal would break records as the most highly valued private company.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Login Without Password Exposure
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into user accounts while protecting private credentials. The technology advances secure automation for personal account management.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva introduced its new image generation model with promised improvements in customization and lower costs. The release makes AI image creation available to all Canva users.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model Amid Competition
cards.body: OpenAI released its decision model competitor as the market for specialized AI agents intensifies. The launch marks OpenAI's bid to compete with established decision-making AI solutions.

cards.title: Microsoft's AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on complex medical cases, according to a Science study. The advancement suggests AI's potential for medical decision support.

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents to Breach Companies
cards.body: Microsoft attributed a ConnectWise breach to China-aligned hackers who deployed AI agents to rapidly compromise thousands of customer networks. The incident demonstrates AI's emerging role in cybercrime.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber expanded its ChatGPT Work deployment from a pilot to all 30,000 employees. The company-wide rollout demonstrates enterprise adoption of AI agents in large organizations.

cards.title: Spotify Positions Itself for AI Agent Era
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström outlined the company's strategy to become the preferred music service for AI agents. The move reflects how streaming platforms are adapting to autonomous AI adoption.

cards.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's next competitive advantage lies not in model choice, but in the infrastructure built around it. Companies must focus on data, engineering, platforms, and governance converging as one cohesive system.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI systems in regulated environments requires a strong foundation across data, engineering, platforms, and governance. These elements must work together seamlessly to support enterprise needs.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI systems can generate recommendations and automate tasks, but they often miss critical business constraints without operational context. Understanding how organizations actually work is essential for AI to make truly right decisions.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: While executives focus on GPU costs for AI, they often overlook the substantial data storage expenses generated during inference. Backend data costs represent a significant but frequently hidden component of total AI infrastructure spending.
